what: rgeoamb: Frameworks for Environmental Analyses in R
title: rgeoamb: Bases para análises ambientais em R
text: rgeoamb R package environmental analysis designed automatically delineate Permanent Preservation Areas (APPs). Key functionalities include extraction Area Perimeter Calculations, APPs slope angles > 45°, Green Area Detection (Áreas Verdes), Hilltops (APPs de Topo de Morros), Land Use Land Cover (LULC) Mapping via Machine Learning (Pixel-Based), Legal Reserve Compliance Percentages Rural Properties, Restricted Use Areas (Áreas de Uso Restrito), Water Bodies (APPs de Corpos Hídricos), Water Mask (Máscara d’água) well upcoming features introduce automated tools Remote Sensing Time Series Analysis.

title: Land Use and Land Cover — landuse_landcover
text: x Input stack raster files. y Input samples (vector files) terra sf package R. target_col Numeric. Target field occurrence. p Numeric. Regarding number samples representing non-occurrence events, suggested, order balance sample set, use sample size equal number event occurrences. drop_cols allows remove information used susceptibility modeling. k_folds Numeric. Number folds number resampling iterations, using cross-validation method. method Random Forest 'rf' Support Vector Machine 'svm' mtry Numeric. Randomly selected predictors ntree Numeric. Decision tree number cost Numeric. Constraint violation cost, 'C' regularization parameter. preProcess Estimates required parameters operation (e.g., 'nzv' near-zero variance filtering, c('center', 'scale') normalization). details available pre-processing methods, see caret package R documentation. path_var_imp Character. Path save machine learning model variable importance tabular format. path_prediction Character. Path save susceptibility prediction raster/matrix format.
